author: Antigravity
description: A refined Momentum Breakout strategy. Targets high momentum moves (Supernova) but filters out 'Blow-off Tops' (Vol > 4.9) and 'Shooting Star' rejections (Upper Shadow > 0.45).
character: Supernova (Breakout). Requires Volume control and Clean Closes.
rule_logic: mom_5d >= 30 AND rsi >= 65 AND vol_ratio <= 4.9 AND upper_shadow_ratio <= 0.45
discovery_notes: AGLD has a 'Split Personality' but the Dip leg returns <5% precision.
Key insight 1: Avoid 'Blow-off Tops'. Volume > 5.0 usually marks the exact top.
Key insight 2: Avoid 'Shooting Stars'. Upper Shadow > 0.45 indicates rejection.
The strategy accepts 'Rational Supernovas' - strong moves that haven't gone vertical enough to crash.
